title: AMBOSS: The Future of Medical Education
description:
🩺 What happens when a doctor's frustration ignites a global learning revolution? This is the compelling story of AMBOSS, the medical learning platform that's changing how doctors learn and practice medicine worldwide.  

✨ We delve into the journey of founder Dr. Siewert Weiss, exploring his early influences, the initial spark of inspiration, and the numerous hurdles he and his team faced in building a med-tech startup from the ground up.  

🌍 From navigating the intricacies of medical licensing to building a platform that students love, we examine the key moments that shaped AMBOSS's remarkable success. This is more than just a business story; it's an exploration of innovation, resilience, and the drive to make a real difference in the world. To help us explore the nuances of AMBOSS's journey and consider the broader implications for the future of learning, we experimented with Google's NotebookLM, an AI-powered tool that offers a tantalizing glimpse into the future of knowledge management.  

🤖 Join us for an inspiring conversation that will leave you thinking about the power of challenging the status quo and building something truly extraordinary.

title: NewStore: Wie Stephan Schambach den Omnichannel-Handel neu definiert
description:
Stephan Schambach, der visionäre Gründer und CEO von NewStore, ist ein Pionier des E-Commerce. Er hat den Online-Handel mit Intershop revolutioniert, ihn mit Demandware in die Cloud gebracht und gestaltet jetzt mit NewStore die Zukunft des Omnichannel-Einzelhandels. Seine Mission ist es, Marken dabei zu helfen, ihre Kunden über alle Kanäle hinweg zu erreichen und zu begeistern. 

Im Founder Story Podcast spricht Stephan offen über seine größten Erfolge und Herausforderungen. Er teilt seine Erfahrungen aus den frühen Tagen des World Wide Web, dem Dotcom-Crash und dem kometenhaften Aufstieg von Demandware. Erfahrt, warum sich große Multilabel-Händler mit der digitalen Transformation schwertun, welche Rolle das Metaverse im Einzelhandel spielt und welche Technologien nach dem Smartphone kommen.

Unter der visionären Führung von Dr. Chung hat Qunomedical es sich zur Aufgabe gemacht, die Barrieren im Gesundheitswesen zu überwinden, indem es transparente, patientenzentrierte Lösungen anbietet. title: The Founder's Story - Lifelong Learning (Wrap-Up) | Google Cloud
description:
In our recent Founder's Story event, led by Google Cloud, we brought together visionary leaders for an in-depth exploration of lifelong learning in entrepreneurship. Mina Saidze, Data \u0026 AI expert and the founder of Inclusive Tech, shared her journey, highlighting the intricacies of diversity and ethics in AI. Her experience provided a rich perspective on the continuous learning curve in the tech world.

The event also featured a panel with Anastasia Barner, Lubomila Jordanova, and Thomas Bachem. These founders discussed their unique paths, offering invaluable insights and practical advice for fellow entrepreneurs and CxOs. Their stories shed light on the realities of growing a business and the importance of adapting and learning at every step.

This video is a key resource for anyone in the startup or scaleup space, looking to glean wisdom from those who have successfully navigated the entrepreneurial landscape.

Watch, learn, and be inspired. And don't forget to subscribe for more content from leaders in the entrepreneurial community :)
